characters.name: Bjørnen
characters.description: Bjørnen is a large, heavyset bear with a thick, shaggy coat of brown fur. He stands tall and robust, with a stout and muscular build typical of a bear preparing for winter. His face is broad with gentle eyes that often express confusion or a naive trust, especially when dealing with Ræven. Bjørnen has a notably short tail in the image where it's frozen in the ice, emphasizing his bewilderment and discomfort. His demeanor is generally calm and easy-going, indicating a trusting and somewhat gullible nature. In the setting where he lies in the sun, he appears content and relaxed. When arguing with Ræven about the butter, Bjørnen's face carries an expression of frustration and disbelief. He is featured in natural settings, from icy holes to sun-soaked hilltops, often accompanied by objects like spruce branches or the empty butter tub.

characters.name: Ræven
characters.description: Ræven is a sly and cunning fox with a sleek and agile build. His fur is a vibrant orange-red with white markings, typical of a fox, which aids in his sneaky and deceptive nature. Ræven's eyes are sharp and shrewd, often narrowed in calculation or mock innocence, and his mouth frequently forms a mischievous grin. He is characterized by his quick movements and stealthy demeanor, constantly alert and ready to act on his schemes. In the images, Ræven sneaks towards the butter tub with a furtive posture, his tail high and ears perked forward. When stealing the butter, he keels over the tub, glancing around to ensure secrecy. His belly appears exaggeratedly full when returning to Bjørnen, a visual cue of his deceit. In scenes where he smears butter on Bjørnen, his actions are smooth and surreptitious. He interacts primarily in forest settings, often near spruce branches or beside the argued-over butter tub, and is constantly plotting his next trick.
